display_name: 独立时频学生源域相位和复增益诊断
description: 比较两个固定独立学生、原始接收及 DURA 的源 IQ 未对齐、理想相位和理想复增益误差。

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output

roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: Source clean IQ privileged phase/gain oracle, not deployment or identity accuracy

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source summary/checkpoint commit, 8192/32768 fit sizes, flags, DURA teacher ancestry and disjoint source pilot
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both students and original DURA source-only with no target ancestry

expected_artifacts: result.json: per-group source raw/phase/gain NMSE for four frozen signals

rows.method: Use source clean per record to compute nested ideal phase and complex gain for two fixed students
rows.purpose: Diagnose whether direct student waveform errors are predominantly global phase/gain
rows.seed_notes: Two pre-existing independently initialized students share model seed and source data sampling rule; the 32768 source IDs include the earlier 8192, with fourfold updates.
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
expected_artifacts: result.json: per-group source raw/phase/gain NMSE for four frozen signals

notes: No F, TX, V, target IQ/truth or parameter updates.
